Chart `tailnet-operator` 0.28.2 (app v0.28.2).
Installation and what the site must provide: [Install the operator](../how-to/install-operator.md).

## Values

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|-----|------|---------|-------------|
| agent.imagePullSecrets | list | `[]` | Default agent pull-secret names, e.g. [dockerconfig]. Tailnet.spec.proxy.imagePullSecrets overrides these. Secrets must exist in each agent namespace. |
| agent.resources | object | `{"limits":{"memory":"128Mi"},"requests":{"cpu":"10m","memory":"32Mi"}}` | Default agent resource block, below CR spec.resources and Tailnet.spec.proxy.resources (no per-key merging). Set null to disable chart defaults; {} does not clear Helm defaults. Changes restart agents that inherit them. Tenant LimitRanges must admit these values. |
| agentImage.digest | string | `""` | Agent digest. An entirely empty agentImage inherits the complete operator image, including its digest. |
| agentImage.repository | string | `""` | Agent repository; empty inherits image.repository. |
| agentImage.tag | string | `""` | Agent tag. With an explicit repository, empty uses Chart.appVersion; otherwise inherits image.tag. |
| console.accessManagement.audit.existingClaim | string | `""` | Use this PersistentVolumeClaim instead of creating one (for example after a restore). |
| console.accessManagement.audit.size | string | `"1Gi"` | Size of the audit volume. The log is never rotated; a change is about 1 KiB. |
| console.accessManagement.audit.storageClassName | string | `""` | StorageClass of the audit volume. Empty: the cluster's default. |
| console.accessManagement.enabled | bool | `false` | Let console admins create, extend and revoke TailnetGrants, and people request access that admins approve. Adds create/update/patch on TailnetGrants and get/list/watch/create on TailnetAccessRequests (with their status) to the console's ClusterRole (delete only with `retentionDays`), a PersistentVolumeClaim `<name>-console-audit` for the hash-chained audit log, a ConfigMap `<name>-console-audit` with the chain's head that only the console may write, and the console's metrics on port 8081 (`metrics`). Apply the TailnetAccessRequest CRD before the upgrade (`task crd-upgrade`). |
| console.accessManagement.fourEyes | bool | `false` | Four-eyes approval: an admin's new grant or extension becomes a request that another admin approves, and a user's request needs two admins. Revoking acts at once. With only one admin, nothing can be approved. |
| console.accessManagement.retentionDays | int | `30` | Days after which the console deletes its expired grants (once the operator reports them `Expired`) and decided requests, and lets pending requests expire. Every deletion is in the audit log first. 0 deletes nothing and gives the console no `delete` right. |
| console.enabled | bool | `false` | Render the web console `<name>-console` (Deployment, Service on port 8080, ServiceAccount, ClusterRole with get/list/watch on Tailnets, TailnetIngresses, TailnetSites and TailnetGrants) and the operator's console API `<name>-console-api` on port 8082 (Service, ClusterRole to create TokenReviews). It only reads unless `console.accessManagement.enabled`. Expose the console with a TailnetIngress in mode `http`; see `deploy/examples/console-ingress.yaml`. |
| console.networkPolicy.idpCIDRs | list | `[]` | Identity provider CIDRs the console may dial (not hostnames). Required when `networkPolicy.enabled` and `console.enabled`. |
| console.networkPolicy.idpPorts | list | `[443]` | Identity provider TCP ports. |
| console.networkPolicy.ingressPeers | list | `[{"podSelector":{"matchLabels":{"app.kubernetes.io/name":"tailnet-ingress"}}}]` | Peers that may reach the console on TCP/8080: the agent of the console's TailnetIngress. Without a namespaceSelector a peer is in the release namespace. Provider cilium translates them to `fromEndpoints` (no ipBlock) and also admits the node (`host`) for the probes. |
| console.oidc.adminGroup | string | `""` | Group whose members are admins. Required when enabled. |
| console.oidc.clientID | string | `""` | OIDC client ID. Required when enabled. |
| console.oidc.clientSecretRef.key | string | `"clientSecret"` | Key of the client secret in that Secret. |
| console.oidc.clientSecretRef.name | string | `""` | Secret in the release namespace holding the client secret. Required when enabled. |
| console.oidc.issuer | string | `""` | OIDC issuer URL (https). Required when enabled. |
| console.oidc.scopes | list | `["openid","profile","email","groups"]` | Requested scopes; must contain `openid`. The role comes from the `groups` claim (ID token, else UserInfo). |
| console.oidc.userGroup | string | `""` | Group whose members are users. Empty: every signed-in person is a user. |
| console.resources | object | `{"limits":{"memory":"128Mi"},"requests":{"cpu":"10m","memory":"64Mi"}}` | Console resource requests and limits. GOMEMLIMIT follows limits.memory. |
| console.url | string | `""` | Public https URL of the console, without a path. Register `<url>/auth/callback` as the redirect URI at the identity provider. Required when enabled. |
| env.extra | list | `[]` | Additional EnvVar entries. POD_NAMESPACE, OPERATOR_IMAGE, AGENT_IMAGE_PULL_SECRETS, AGENT_RESOURCES, SSL_CERT_FILE and SSL_CERT_DIR are reserved. |
| fullnameOverride | string | `""` | Override the resource name with a letter-first DNS label (at most 53 characters). Install only one operator per cluster. |
| headscale.caConfigMapRef.key | string | `"ca.crt"` | Key of the PEM bundle in that ConfigMap. |
| headscale.caConfigMapRef.name | string | `""` | ConfigMap in the operator namespace holding a PEM bundle the operator trusts for an https `apiUrl` in addition to the public roots (the issuer CA behind Headscale's own certificate). Empty: public roots only. |
| image.digest | string | `""` | Optional sha256 digest; takes precedence over the tag. |
| image.pullPolicy | string | `"IfNotPresent"` | Operator pull policy. |
| image.repository | string | `"docker.io/ff0x/tailnet-operator"` | Operator image repository. Verify mirror availability before installation. |
| image.tag | string | `""` | Image tag; empty uses Chart.appVersion. |
| imagePullSecrets | list | `[]` | Pull-secret references for the operator pod, e.g. [{name: dockerconfig}]. |
| leaderElection.enabled | bool | `true` | Elect one active operator using a Lease in the operator namespace. Disable only for a single replica with Recreate updates. |
| monitoring.dashboard.allowCrossNamespaceImport | bool | `true` | Allow Grafana Operator to import into matching instances in other namespaces. |
| monitoring.dashboard.datasourceName | string | `"Prometheus"` | Grafana Operator datasource name mapped to the bundled DS_PROMETHEUS input. Sidecar users must configure input substitution separately. |
| monitoring.dashboard.enabled | bool | `false` | Render the bundled dashboard, or the json override below. Disabled by default. |
| monitoring.dashboard.folder | string | `"Tailnet"` | Grafana Operator dashboard folder. |
| monitoring.dashboard.instanceSelector | object | `{"matchLabels":{"grafana.internal/instance":"grafana"}}` | Grafana Operator instance selector. |
| monitoring.dashboard.json | string | `""` | Nonempty JSON replaces the bundled dashboard; custom JSON is not template evaluated. |
| monitoring.dashboard.kind | string | `"GrafanaDashboard"` | GrafanaDashboard requires Grafana Operator v5 CRDs; ConfigMap supports dashboard sidecars. |
| monitoring.dashboard.labels | object | `{"grafana_dashboard":"1"}` | Labels for the dashboard resource, including the optional ConfigMap sidecar label. |
| monitoring.podMonitor.enabled | bool | `false` | Scrape generated agents on health TCP/9080 and gateways on kernel-health TCP/8080 + metrics-dns TCP/9153. Requires PodMonitor CRD; allow your Prometheus through scrapeFrom. |
| monitoring.podMonitor.interval | string | `"30s"` | Agent scrape interval. |
| monitoring.podMonitor.labels | object | `{}` | Additional PodMonitor labels for your Prometheus selector. |
| monitoring.podMonitor.namespaceSelector | object | `{"any":true}` | Agent namespace selection. Set any: false with matchNames to restrict namespaces; any: false without names selects only the PodMonitor namespace. |
| monitoring.podMonitor.scrapeFrom | list | `[]` | NetworkPolicy peers (namespaceSelector / podSelector / ipBlock) that may scrape the generated agents on TCP/9080, rendered into every agent NetworkPolicy next to the operator. Empty adds none. Gateways carry no policy. |
| monitoring.rules.apiKeyExpiryWarningSeconds | int | `604800` | API-key expiry warning threshold in seconds (7 days). For shorter key lifetimes, set below half-life to avoid warning before normal rotation. |
| monitoring.rules.authKeyExpiryWarningSeconds | int | `86400` | Egress/ingress auth-key expiry warning threshold in seconds (1 day). For shorter key lifetimes, set below half-life to avoid warning before normal rotation. |
| monitoring.rules.enabled | bool | `false` | Render a PrometheusRule. Requires Prometheus Operator CRDs. |
| monitoring.rules.groups | list | `[]` | Nonempty groups replace all bundled rules, without merging or template evaluation. |
| monitoring.serviceMonitor.enabled | bool | `false` | Requires Prometheus Operator CRDs. Disabled for a fresh Kubernetes installation. |
| monitoring.serviceMonitor.interval | string | `"30s"` | Scrape interval. |
| monitoring.serviceMonitor.labels | object | `{}` | Additional ServiceMonitor labels for your Prometheus selector. |
| namespace | string | `""` | Operator namespace; empty uses the Helm release namespace. Bootstrap and working keys live here. |
| networkPolicy.cilium.headscalePeers | list | `[{"podSelector":{"matchLabels":{"app.kubernetes.io/name":"headscale"}}}]` | Headscale peers for provider cilium (namespaceSelector / podSelector; no ipBlock). Without a namespaceSelector the peer is scoped to the operator namespace. Set to `[]` when the Headscale control plane is reached by IP via `headscaleCIDRs` instead. |
| networkPolicy.dnsPeers | list | `[{"namespaceSelector":{"matchLabels":{"kubernetes.io/metadata.name":"kube-system"}},"podSelector":{"matchLabels":{"k8s-app":"kube-dns"}}}]` | DNS NetworkPolicy peers; customize for NodeLocal DNS or a different resolver. |
| networkPolicy.enabled | bool | `false` | Enable operator isolation. With provider kubernetes this requires explicit kubeAPI and Headscale CIDRs; CNI Service-DNAT behavior must be checked locally. |
| networkPolicy.headscaleCIDRs | list | `[]` | Headscale API endpoint CIDRs (not hostnames). Required for provider kubernetes; optional for provider cilium (renders a `toCIDR` egress for a remote Headscale). Update when the DNS address changes; prefer the stable control-plane IPs over resolver-dependent values. |
| networkPolicy.headscalePorts | list | `[443,8080]` | Headscale REST API TCP ports. |
| networkPolicy.kubeAPICIDRs | list | `[]` | API endpoint and/or Service CIDRs appropriate for your CNI, e.g. [10.96.0.1/32]. Required for provider kubernetes. |
| networkPolicy.kubeAPIPorts | list | `[443,6443]` | Kubernetes API TCP ports. |
| networkPolicy.metricsPeers | list | `[]` | Peers permitted to scrape metrics (provider kubernetes). Empty denies metrics ingress when isolation is enabled. |
| networkPolicy.provider | string | `"kubernetes"` | `kubernetes` renders a NetworkPolicy (ingress and egress, ipBlock-based). `cilium` renders a CiliumNetworkPolicy using `toEntities: kube-apiserver`, label selectors and `toCIDR`; ipBlock peers in `dnsPeers`/`cilium.headscalePeers` are rejected, requires the cilium.io/v2 CRDs. Its ingress stays open without the console; with `console.enabled` only the console reaches TCP/8082, while metrics (8080) and health (8081) stay open to all (`metricsPeers` is not applied). For a Headscale that lives outside the cluster (shared control plane, spoke clusters) set `cilium.headscalePeers: []` and populate `headscaleCIDRs` — the template renders a `toCIDR` egress for the Headscale IPs on `headscalePorts`. |
| networkPolicy.spokeCIDRs | list | `[]` | Spoke API server CIDRs the operator may dial directly (an address outside the cluster). Empty adds nothing. |
| networkPolicy.spokePeers | list | `[]` | Peers (namespaceSelector / podSelector; no ipBlock under provider cilium) the operator may dial for `Tailnet.spec.policy.spokes[]`. A spoke API server reached through a TailnetEgress is that CR's agent pod: select `app.kubernetes.io/name: tailnet-egress` + `app.kubernetes.io/instance: <egress name>` and put its listen port into `spokePorts`. Empty adds nothing. |
| networkPolicy.spokePorts | list | `[443,6443]` | TCP ports for `spokePeers` and `spokeCIDRs`; an egress agent listens on its target's listen port (first target 10000). |
| podSecurityContext | object | `{"runAsGroup":65532,"runAsNonRoot":true,"runAsUser":65532,"seccompProfile":{"type":"RuntimeDefault"}}` | Pod security context; the scratch image requires a numeric non-root UID. |
| policy.fragmentReader.configMaps | list | `[]` | Fragment ConfigMaps (operator namespace) the reader may read; usually the spoke Tailnet's `<tailnet>-policy-fragment`. |
| policy.fragmentReader.enabled | bool | `false` | On a spoke: render a ServiceAccount, a Role limited to get/list/watch on the listed fragment ConfigMaps, a RoleBinding and a long-lived token Secret `<name>-fragment-reader-token`. Build the hub's spoke kubeconfig from that token and this cluster's CA. |
| replicas | int | `1` | Operator replicas; more than one requires leaderElection.enabled. A PDB with minAvailable=1 is rendered for multiple replicas. |
| resources | object | `{"limits":{"memory":"192Mi"},"requests":{"cpu":"25m","memory":"64Mi"}}` | Operator resource requests and limits. GOMEMLIMIT follows limits.memory. |
| securityContext | object | `{"allowPrivilegeEscalation":false,"capabilities":{"drop":["ALL"]},"readOnlyRootFilesystem":true}` | Operator container hardening. Agents are configured separately by the controller. |
| topologySpreadConstraints | list | `[]` | Optional operator pod topology spread constraints. Supply a labelSelector matching app.kubernetes.io/name: tailnet-operator. |
